Hi everyone! 
I'm Vietnamese, I’m looking for a room/place to stay in San Francisco and planning to move in around early August.
A little about me:
Female, 23 years old
Incoming student at SFSU for Fall 2026
Friendly, respectful, and easy to get along with
Allergic to dogs and cats
What I’m looking for:
Near SFSU for convenient commuting
Female-only roommates/housemates
No pets (especially dogs/cats)
I’m okay with sharing a room
No parking needed
Please text me if you have any available room that might fit! You can also leave your contact info in the comments and I’ll reach out as soon as possible. Thank you so much!

Looking for a short-term stay for a male friend in San Francisco, preferably around Dogpatch, Potrero Hill, or Mission Bay.
 Dates: June 18 – July 8 (3–4 weeks)
Open to sublets, furnished rooms, shared apartments, or any leads in the area. Please DM me if you know of anything available. Thanks!

Looking for Housing/ Lease takeover in San Francisco (July Move-In)
Hi everyone! I’m looking for either:
• A studio or 1 bed / 1 bath apartment, or
• A room in a 2 bed / 2 bath shared apartment with a female roommate
starting in July. Ideally seeking a long-term lease, lease takeover, or renewal opportunity.
 Budget: Up to $3,000/month
A little about me:
• Working professional in tech
• Clean, quiet, and respectful
• Enjoy hiking, running, and exploring the city
• Looking for a comfortable place to call home in SF
Preferred neighborhoods:
 Marina
 Pacific Heights
 Embarcadero
 Nob Hill
 Russian Hill
 Mission Bay
 Mission Dolores / Mission District
 Potrero Hill
 Dogpatch
I’m also open to other neighborhoods if it’s a good fit.
If you have a place available or know someone looking for a roommate, please DM me. Thanks in advance! See less

Hey everyone! I'm a Stanford MBA student looking to sublet in SF from June 10 – August 16. Ideally a furnished studio or 1BR in Hayes Valley, Lower/Upper Pac Heights, the Castro, Mission, or SoMa/Mission Bay. Happy to provide references. If you or anyone you know has something available, please reach out! 
https://www.linkedin.com/in/malik-russell/

Hey everyone! I’m a medical student rotating with UCSF orthopedic surgery from June 26th-July 26th. Looking to sublease any available unit in Dogpatch / Potrero Hill / Mission Bay / Mission District ASAP.
Please DM me if you have anything available. Thanks!

Looking for a Studio / 1B1B in San Francisco (June 1st Move-In)
Hi everyone! I’m urgently looking for a studio or 1 bed / 1 bath apartment in San Francisco starting June 1st for a one-month lease (or flexible short-term arrangement).
 Budget: $2,500–$3,000/month, though I’m willing to stretch for the right place.
A little about me:
• Clean, quiet, and respectful tenant
• Work in tech
• Looking for a temporary place while I search for a long-term apartment in the city
Preferred neighborhoods:
 Marina
 Pacific Heights
 Embarcadero
 Nob Hill
 Russian Hill
I’m also open to other neighborhoods if it’s a good fit.
If you have a place available or know of any leads, please send me a DM. Thanks in advance!
Hi! I'm new to this group. I recently joined because I am looking for a temporary place to stay in SF

Hi everyone!
Looking for housing in San Francisco from June 15 through November (flexible on dates)
Ideally looking for a studio or 1-bedroom, but open to different options
Please message me if you have something available. Thank you!

Urgent 
 looking for a studio or a room, Budget max $1500, June 1st move in
Location can be anywhere as long as its within SF and SJ
priority : parking, pet allowance (I have a kitten who’s only 2 months old), chill and easy going housemates, and most importantly, guests allowed (My boyfriend comes over often)
I can meet up in person if there’s a room im really interested in so please send me a text in private chat box.
insta @a_w_ngel
Looking for someone to join our sweet, sunny North Oakland home! It's a small room but there are several excellent common spaces including a nice backyard and giant basement! Must love dogs.

Looking for SF Summer Sublet ASAP
I’m looking for a summer sublet ASAP through Aug 22. I can move quickly and sign the lease/sublease after seeing the apartment in person.
I’m in SF for a summer internship and will be working in-office near 945 Market Street 5 days/week.
Looking for a studio, 1B1B, or room in a clean apartment. Budget is around $2.5k–$2.7k/month, flexible for the right place.
About me: clean, quiet, respectful, don’t smoke, don’t party, and will mostly be busy with work.
If you’re subletting or know someone with a place, please DM me. Happy to share LinkedIn, proof of internship, or hop on a quick call.

Mid-20s Seeking Room for Rent < $2k
Hi all! I’m looking for a room to rent in a shared apartment with 1-3 roommates, $1500-$2000. I’d like to be in a central neighborhood such as Haight-Ashbury, Cole Valley, Nopa, Duboce, or Mission Dolores. Long term lease and I’m flexible on move-in: June, July, or August. Looking for LGBTQ+ friendly housing 
About me:
My name is JP (they/them) and I’m a young professional working in water engineering. I’m originally from the East Bay and studied civil engineering at UC Davis. In my free time, I love to play volleyball, take dance lessons, hike, and chat over boba with friends.
I’ve lived with roommates for 4+ years and love a chore chart to keep shared spaces clean and clutter-free. I’m considerate about cleaning up after myself in the kitchen and respecting shared items. I have a good credit score and always pay rent on time.
When it comes to a living environment, I’m looking to be friends with my roommates and have a social/lively household. Although I’m an independent person and value alone time, I find having a welcoming space to come home to is super important.
If I sound like a good fit for your apartment you can send me a message on Facebook! See less

Looking for two 2-bedroom unit in Dogpatch / Potrero Hill / Mission Bay / Mission District
Hey everyone, I’m looking for two 2-bedroom units in the same building (or within 5 minutes walking distance) around Dogpatch/ Potrero Hill/ Mission Bay/ Mission District from June 20 to Sept 20.
Please dm me if you are renting out. Thanks!

Hi everyone — I’m looking for a furnished 2-bedroom sublet near Three Embarcadero Center for my husband, who will be in SF for his investment banking summer internship.
Dates: June 6 – August 8
Areas: FiDi, Embarcadero, Rincon Hill, South Beach, North Beach, Telegraph Hill, East Nob Hill, SoMa
Budget: flexible
Please DM me if you have anything available or know of any leads. See less

Hi, I am Ankit and urgently looking for apartment/room rentals in Bay area in shared accommodation with my partner. Preferably in San Jose, Santa Clara, Campbell, Sunnyvale and Mountain View. But also open to locations in Fremont, Milpitas, Newark.
Please share any leads or details. We have a budget of $1200 and planning to move in by 1st July but flexible to move-in by mid/end June. 
Both of us have been living together for 2 years and will be sharing the room. She works with Handshake company in Hybrid mode. Let me know if any more details are needed from our end! 
Really appreciate any leads or help Thanks! See less

Hi! I am looking for a room/bed/couch to stay on from June 22nd-August 15th! I'm a college student at Dartmouth and have a paid internship  in Oakland :) (interning for CROP | Creating Restorative Opportunities & Programs). [
](https://www.croporganization.org/)

Hey everyone!
My name is Ivan Bugankov, I’m 19, and I’m currently a student at City College of San Francisco. I’m looking for a place for a long-term stay, with a move-in date around June 17 or anytime after that.
A bit about me:
I’m a very responsible, quiet, and organized person. I don’t smoke, don’t have pets, and I prioritize keeping my living space clean and respectful.
I’m looking for a room for myself, but I’m completely open to living with roommates! I value a friendly environment and get along great with people of all backgrounds.
If you have an available room, a lease to fill, or want to team up to find a place together, please feel free to send me a DM! I’m also down to schedule a tour/meet-up and am quite flexible with my schedule.
Looking forward to connecting! See less

Hello everyone! My name is Shreyas — I’m 24 and passively looking to move back into SF.
A little about me:
• Bay Area native, currently working in tech sales near the city (back in office 4 days/week, so the commute is calling me back 
)
• Love going out, exploring events around the city, trying new restaurants/coffee shops, and meeting new people
• Big people person — I genuinely enjoy learning about others’ interests and perspectives
• Clean, organized, and respectful in shared spaces. I like keeping a good home environment and am always happy to host friends/family occasionally
• Lived in the city for about a year before moving out for an investment opportunity, but excited to be back
What I’m looking for:
• Neighborhoods: open to places with good natural light, a view, and/or strong walkability — whether that’s city views or accessible to a water body. Open to locations however would prefer FiDi, Nob Hill, Marina, Cow Hollow, Market St high-rises, or somewhere with walkable access to the water
• Budget: flexible, roughly $2k–$3k for a private room + bathroom
• Roommates: social, adventurous, respectful, and fun people who enjoy a good home vibe
• Bonus: vegetarian or vegetarian-friendly!
• Move-in timeline: ideally July–September
I’m open to joining an existing apartment/house search, joining others to find a place, or filling a vacancy if you think I’d be a good fit. 
Feel free to message me here or reach out on Instagram: @shreyaspras See less

Hi! I’m looking for a sublet in San Francisco from 8–14 June. Preferably a studio or a room in a shared accommodation.
Please DM me if you have any leads. Thanks!

Looking for a Furnished Room | Late June – Late July/August (Flexible)
Hi everyone! 
My husband and I are looking for a furnished room in San Francisco from late June through late July or August (dates are flexible).
We're 26 and 28, clean, respectful, and easygoing. We love exploring the city, trying new restaurants and bars, and we're excited to meet new people while we're there.
Ideally, we'd love to stay in Hayes Valley, but we're open to nearby neighborhoods as well.
Budget: up to $2,400/month.
If you have a room available or know of anything, please DM me. Thanks! 
 See less

Hi everyone! I’m looking for a furnished room, studio, ADU, or short-term sublet for my summer internship in South San Francisco.
Dates: June 7 to August 21, 2026
Location: I’ll be commuting to the South San Francisco biotech / Oyster Point area.
Commute: Ideally within ~60 minutes by public transit, walking, or bike. SSF, San Bruno, Millbrae, Daly City, Burlingame, San Mateo, Dogpatch, Mission Bay, Potrero, or SoMa near Caltrain could work.
About me:
- Princeton student
- Summer intern in biotech
- Quiet, clean, respectful, non-smoker
- One person, no pets
Looking for:
- Furnished room / studio / ADU / 1BR / sublet
- Desk or usable work surface is important
- Kitchen access is strongly preferred
- Month-to-month or fixed summer sublet is ideal
- Budget is flexible for the right place, but lower cost is better
If you have something available, please DM me with:
1. Nearest cross streets or neighborhood
2. Available dates
3. Monthly rent + utilities + deposit
4. Whether there is a desk/table and kitchen access
5. Photos or video tour if available
Thanks! See less
Looking for a 4 bed (5 bed also works) apartment with at least 2 full bathrooms in San Francisco. Please let me know if you have anything!

Hey everyone! Nice to meet y'all. My name is Shalin and I'm moving from Seattle to SF in the first week of July for a new job and am looking for roommates.
My job is in Fidi, like near 2nd street, so I'm looking for something around that area ish, but am fine with something further away. My budget is anywhere from 2.5k-3k.
A bit more about me:
Went to school in Illinois (UIUC) studying CS, then moved to Seattle in September of 2024 after graduating in May. I'm 24 and a software engineer whose been working in AI and the video streaming space. I'll probably be working a lot, but I'm super social and like doing things with my roommates and other friends in the area. I love trying new food, lifting, playing/watching sports and going to concerts (also always down for new hobbies/things to do). I definitely want to host things, but do not want to have a party apt/house.
Shoot me a message or comment if you're interested! See less

Looking for someone to fill a room in a 2 Bed / 2 Bath apartment in South San Francisco!
Location:
* 3 blocks from the Caltrain station and a 10 min Bus Ride from the South SF BART Station
* ~15 min ride to Downtown SF
* ~28 mins to Redwood City
* ~35 mins to Palo Alto
* Great spot for anyone working in SF, the Peninsula, or nearby biotech hubs
* Walking distance to a lot of good restaurants, cafes, and everyday essentials
 Apartment:
* ~1100 sq ft
* Earliest Move in date June 27, latest is July 6th
* Private bedroom + bathroom
* Rent: $2,200/month
* Parking Spot Included
* Building includes access to Courtyard, Common Room Space, Rooftop, Bike Storage and Grills
* Utilities usually come out to around $40–70/month per person after split
* 1 year lease
A bit about me:
I’m about 3 years out of college and currently work in tech in the South Bay. I commute into the office most days but WFH sometimes too. I like going out on weekends, traveling, hiking/nature, cooking, and music events. I’ll occasionally have friends over for dinner, but overall keep things pretty chill. I also travel out of town at least once a month.
Would love to find someone clean, respectful, and easygoing. Message me if interested or if you want more details/photos! See less

Hey everyone! My name’s Thomas, I’m 23, and I’m planning to move to SF around July/August. Wanted to see if anyone is looking for a roommate, needs someone to fill a room, or is interested in apartment hunting together.
Ideally I’d love to be in Marina, Cow Hollow, or Pac Heights, but I’m definitely open to other neighborhoods too for the right setup/people.
A little about me:
Working in public accounting
Pretty social and easygoing
Into working out, binge-watching TV shows, grabbing food/drinks, exploring the city, and honestly anything fun/social
Big fan of a clean apartment and respectful roommates
Definitely enjoy going out, but also appreciate quieter nights during the week
Would love to live with people who are friendly, chill, communicative, and down to make the place feel like an actual home instead of just random roommates.
If you have a room available, are looking for roommates, or want to apartment hunt together, feel free to message me! See less
